name: Booty Bay or Bust!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Listen, kid, you're not gonna learn anything hanging around here.

I know a guy who knows a guy. He hangs around the smithy in Booty Bay. If you show him this insignia, he'll tell you all about mithril.

So whadd'ya say? Leave this kid stuff to the babies in diapers, adventurer -- it's time to move on.

If you're interested, his name's McGavan. Show him this trinket and he'll recognize your commitment.
narrative.objectives: Speak with McGavan in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: By Blackhoof's back hair -- finally, one worthy of the Mithril Order!
narrative.requestItemsText: A rare breed your kind be, matey. Let me see that insignia.
